name: Molten Metals Corp
summary: Molten Metals Corp. primarily focuses on the exploration of mineral deposits. The company holds an exclusive option to acquire complete ownership (100% interest) of the West Gore Antimony/Gold property. This significant asset comprises 37 adjoining mineral claims and four exploration permits, collectively spanning 585 hectares within central Nova Scotia. Originally incorporated as Battery Elements Corp., the company rebranded to Molten Metals Corp. in June 2022. The company was founded in 2020 and its corporate headquarters are situated in Vancouver, Canada.
